title: Ruislip Emergency Help Points
summary: Emergency medical, urgent care, and local readiness help points in Ruislip.
content: For immediate life-threatening emergencies, call 999 or 112 right away. 1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals: Hillingdon Hospital (Pield Heath Road, Uxbridge UB8 3NN) — 24-hour A&E. Travel from Ruislip station: ~4 miles south-west; take bus U1 or U10 to Uxbridge, or bus 114 to Ruislip Manor then connect to local routes (~30 mins). Northwick Park Hospital (Watford Road, Harrow HA1 3UJ) — 24-hour A&E. Travel from South Ruislip station: ~5 miles east; take bus 114 towards Harrow/Mill Hill (~30 mins). Nearest Major Trauma Centre is St Mary's Hospital (Praed Street, Paddington W2 1NY). 2. NHS Urgent Treatment Centres: Mount Vernon Hospital Minor Injuries Unit (Rickmansworth Road, Northwood HA6 2RN) — daily 8am to 8pm for cuts, fractures, and minor wounds. Travel from Ruislip High Street: take bus 331 north along High Street towards Northwood (~15 mins). Northwick Park Urgent Treatment Centre (co-located at Northwick Park Hospital, Watford Road HA1 3UJ) — open 24 hours. 3. Local Hazard Notes: The River Pinn crosses Ruislip from north-east to south-west; flood risk affects areas near King's College Playing Fields, Kingsend, and Pinn Meadows after heavy rainfall. Ruislip Lido is a large open body of water to the north. 4. Supplies: High Street in Ruislip, Victoria Road in Ruislip Manor, and Field End Road in Eastcote host pharmacies and large food stores for emergency medicines and water. Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
